resources.string: Connect once with the six-digit code the Mac shows. After that, this device finds the Mac by itself.
Ready to send pages over Wi-Fi.
On the Mac, open God\'s Camera and, under Scanner, turn on “Receive scans on this Mac”. The Mac and this device must be on the same Wi-Fi network.
This device was removed on the Mac. Connect again with a new code.
Connected to the Mac through the debugging connection.
The Mac answered, but did not accept the token.
The Mac cannot be reached through the debugging connection.
Photograph pages with the camera. Edges are found and straightened for you.
Use photos or screenshots you already have.
The document scanner is not available on this device.
Scan a document or choose photos. A long page can be taken in several photos that overlap; the Mac joins them into one text.
Connect to a Mac to send the pages.
The Mac is reading the text… %d %%
Pictures: %1$d · Lines read: %2$d · Repeated lines removed: %3$d
The Mac found no text in these pages.
The Mac could not be reached
Check that God\'s Camera is open on the Mac and that both are on the same Wi-Fi network. Your pages are still here.
The Mac did not accept this device
This device was removed on the Mac. Connect again with a new code. Your pages are still here.
The Mac could not read these pages
Try again, or take the photos once more with more light. Your pages are still here.
On the Mac, open God\'s Camera and go to Scanner.
Click “Connect a phone or tablet”. The Mac shows a six-digit code.
Choose the Mac below and enter the code.
Looking for Macs… The Mac and this device must be on the same Wi-Fi network, with God\'s Camera open on the Mac.
For example 192.168.1.20. You find it on the Mac under System Settings, Wi-Fi, Details.
That does not look like an address.
No Mac with God\'s Camera answered at that address.
The code is on the Mac\'s screen and works for a few minutes.
That code did not work. Check the six digits on the Mac and enter them again.
The Mac is not showing a code right now. On the Mac, click “Connect a phone or tablet” to get a new one.
The Mac could not be reached. Check that both are on the same Wi-Fi network.
The Mac has as many devices connected as it takes. Remove one on the Mac first.
From now on this device finds the Mac by itself whenever both are on the same Wi-Fi network.
This device will no longer send pages to it. To use it again, connect with a new code.
